paragraphs.sourceText: In spite of “endless talk of difference,” American society is an amazing machine for homogenizing people. There is “the democratizing uniformity of dress and discourse, and the casualness and absence of deference” characteristic of popular culture. People are absorbed into “a culture of consumption” launched by the 19th-century department stores that offered “vast arrays of goods in an elegant atmosphere. Instead of intimate shops catering to a knowledgeable elite,” these were stores “anyone could enter, regardless of class or background. This turned shopping into a public and democratic act.” The mass media, advertising and sports are other forces for homogenization.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管“无休止地谈论差异”，美国社会仍然是一台令人惊奇的使人同质化的机器。流行文化具有“着装和言论的民主化统一，以及随意和缺乏尊重”的特征。人们被19世纪百货商店推出的“消费文化”所吸引，这种文化“在优雅的氛围中提供种类繁多的商品。这些商店不再是迎合知识精英的私密商店”，而是“任何人都可以进入，无论阶级或背景。这将购物变成了一种公共和民主的行为。”大众媒体、广告和体育是同质化的其他力量。

paragraphs.sourceText: Immigrants are quickly fitting into this common culture, which may not be altogether elevating but is hardly poisonous. Writing for the National Immigration Forum, Gregory Rodriguez reports that today’s immigration is neither at unprecedented levels nor resistant to assimilation. In 1998 immigrants were 9.8 percent of the population; in 1900, 13.6 percent. In the 10 years prior to 1990, 3.1 immigrants arrived for every 1,000 residents; in the 10 years prior to 1890, 9.2 for every 1,000. Now, consider three indices of assimilation — language, home ownership and intermarriage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 移民正在迅速融入这种共同文化，这种文化可能并不完全令人振奋，但也绝非有毒。格雷戈里·罗德里格斯（Gregory Rodriguez）在国家移民论坛上撰文称，当今的移民既没有达到前所未有的水平，也没有抵制同化。 1998年，移民占总人口的9.8%； 1900 年为 13.6%。 1990年之前的10年里，每1000名居民就有3.1名移民抵达； 1890年之前的10年，每1000人中有9.2人。现在，考虑三个同化指标——语言、住房所有权和通婚。

paragraphs.sourceText: Stratford-on-Avon, as we all know, has only one industry — William Shakespeare — but there are two distinctly separate and increasingly hostile branches. There is the Royal Shakespeare Company (RSC), which presents superb productions of the plays at the Shakespeare Memorial Theatre on the Avon. And there are the townsfolk who largely live off the tourists who come, not to see the plays, but to look at Anne Hathaway’s Cottage, Shakespeare’s birthplace and the other sights.
paragraphs.translationZh: 众所周知，埃文河畔斯特拉特福只有一个行业——威廉·莎士比亚——但有两个截然不同且日益敌对的分支。皇家莎士比亚剧团 (RSC) 在埃文河畔的莎士比亚纪念剧院上演精彩的戏剧作品。还有一些镇民主要依靠游客为生，游客来不是为了看戏剧，而是为了参观安妮海瑟薇的小屋、莎士比亚的出生地和其他景点。

paragraphs.sourceText: The worthy residents of Stratford doubt that the theater adds a penny to their revenue. They frankly dislike the RSC’s actors, them with their long hair and beards and sandals and noisiness. It’s all deliciously ironic when you consider that Shakespeare, who earns their living, was himself an actor (with a beard) and did his share of noise-making.
paragraphs.translationZh: 斯特拉特福的可敬居民怀疑剧院是否会给他们增加一分钱的收入。坦率地说，他们不喜欢英国皇家莎士比亚剧团的演员，他们留着长发、胡须、穿着凉鞋，而且吵闹。当你想到以谋生为生的莎士比亚本人也是一名演员（留着胡子）并做了他的那份制造噪音的事情时，这一切都是非常讽刺的。

paragraphs.sourceText: The tourist streams are not entirely separate. The sightseers who come by bus — and often take in Warwick Castle and Blenheim Palace on the side — don’t usually see the plays, and some of them are even surprised to find a theatre in Stratford. However, the playgoers do manage a little sight-seeing along with their playgoing. It is the playgoers, the RSC contends, who bring in much of the town’s revenue because they spend the night (some of them four or five nights) pouring cash into the hotels and restaurants. The sightseers can take in everything and get out of town by nightfall.
paragraphs.translationZh: 旅游流并不是完全分开的。乘坐巴士前来的观光客——经常顺便参观沃里克城堡和布莱尼姆宫——通常看不到戏剧，其中一些人甚至惊讶地发现斯特拉特福有一座剧院。然而，观众们在观看比赛的同时也确实进行了一些观光活动。 RSC 认为，正是游客为该镇带来了大部分收入，因为他们在酒店和餐馆过夜（有些是四到五晚），将现金投入其中。观光者可以参观一切，并在夜幕降临时离开城镇。

paragraphs.sourceText: The townsfolk don’t see it this way and the local council does not contribute directly to the subsidy of the Royal Shakespeare Company. Stratford cries poor traditionally. Nevertheless every hotel in town seems to be adding a new wing or cocktail lounge. Hilton is building its own hotel there, which you may be sure will be decorated with Hamlet Hamburger Bars, the Lear Lounge, the Banquo Banqueting Room, and so forth, and will be very expensive.
paragraphs.translationZh: 镇民并不这么认为，地方议会也不直接为皇家莎士比亚剧团提供补贴。斯特拉特福传统上哭穷。尽管如此，城里的每家酒店似乎都在增加一个新的翼楼或鸡尾酒廊。希尔顿正在那里建造自己的酒店，您可以肯定，酒店将装饰有哈姆雷特汉堡酒吧、李尔酒廊、班柯宴会厅等，而且价格非常昂贵。

paragraphs.sourceText: Anyway, the townsfolk can’t understand why the Royal Shakespeare Company needs a subsidy. (The theatre has broken attendance records for three years in a row. Last year its 1,431 seats were 94 per cent occupied all year long and this year they’ll do better.) The reason, of course, is that costs have rocketed and ticket prices have stayed low.
paragraphs.translationZh: 无论如何，镇民们无法理解为什么皇家莎士比亚剧团需要补贴。 （剧院连续三年打破上座率记录。去年，1,431个座位全年上座率为94%，今年会做得更好。）当然，原因是成本飙升，而票价却保持在较低水平。

paragraphs.sourceText: It would be a shame to raise prices too much because it would drive away the young people who are Stratford’s most attractive clientele. They come entirely for the plays, not the sights. They all seem to look alike (though they come from all over) — lean, pointed, dedicated faces, wearing jeans and sandals, eating their buns and bedding down for the night on the flagstones outside the theatre to buy the 20 seats and 80 standing-room tickets held for the sleepers and sold to them when the box office opens at 10:30 a.m.
paragraphs.translationZh: 价格提得太高将是一种耻辱，因为它会赶走斯特拉特福最有吸引力的客户群年轻人。他们完全是为了看戏，而不是为了看风景。他们看起来都很相似（尽管他们来自世界各地）——精瘦、尖尖、专注的面孔，穿着牛仔裤和凉鞋，吃着面包，在剧院外的石板上过夜，购买为卧铺票准备的 20 个座位和 80 个站票，并在上午 10:30 售票处开放时出售给他们。

paragraphs.sourceText: When prehistoric man arrived in new parts of the world, something strange happened to the large animals: they suddenly became extinct. Smaller species survived. The large, slow-growing animals were easy game, and were quickly hunted to extinction. Now something similar could be happening in the oceans.
paragraphs.translationZh: 当史前人类到达世界新的地方时，大型动物发生了一些奇怪的事情：它们突然灭绝了。较小的物种幸存下来。这种体型大、生长缓慢的动物很容易被猎杀，但很快就被猎杀至灭绝。现在海洋中也可能发生类似的事情。

paragraphs.sourceText: That the seas are being overfished has been known for years. What researchers such as Ransom Myers and Boris Worm have shown is just how fast things are changing. They have looked at half a century of data from fisheries around the world. Their methods do not attempt to estimate the actual biomass (the amount of living biological matter) of fish species in particular parts of the ocean, but rather changes in that biomass over time. According to their latest paper published in Nature, the biomass of large predators (animals that kill and eat other animals) in a new fishery is reduced on average by 80% within 15 years of the start of exploitation. In some long-fished areas, it has halved again since then.
paragraphs.translationZh: 多年来，人们都知道海洋正在被过度捕捞。兰塞姆·迈尔斯 (Ransom Myers) 和鲍里斯·沃姆 (Boris Worm) 等研究人员已经证明，事情的变化速度有多快。他们研究了半个世纪以来世界各地渔业的数据。他们的方法并不试图估计海洋特定部分鱼类的实际生物量（活生物物质的数量），而是估计该生物量随时间的变化。根据他们在《自然》杂志上发表的最新论文，新渔业中大型捕食者（杀死并吃掉其他动物的动物）的生物量在开始开发后的 15 年内平均减少了 80%。在一些长期捕捞的地区，此后又减半了。

paragraphs.sourceText: Dr. Worm acknowledges that these figures are conservative. One reason for this is that fishing technology has improved. Today’s vessels can find their prey using satellites and sonar, which were not available 50 years ago. That means a higher proportion of what is in the sea is being caught, so the real difference between present and past is likely to be worse than the one recorded by changes in catch sizes. In the early days, too, longlines would have been more saturated with fish. Some individuals would therefore not have been caught, since no baited hooks would have been available to trap them, leading to an underestimate of fish stocks in the past. Furthermore, in the early days of longline fishing, a lot of fish were lost to sharks after they had been hooked. That is no longer a problem, because there are fewer sharks around now.
paragraphs.translationZh: 沃姆博士承认这些数字是保守的。造成这种情况的原因之一是捕鱼技术的进步。如今的船只可以利用卫星和声纳来寻找猎物，而这在 50 年前是无法实现的。这意味着海洋中捕获的鱼的比例更高，因此现在和过去之间的真正差异可能比捕获量变化记录的差异更严重。在早期，延绳钓中的鱼也更加饱和。因此，有些个体不会被捕获，因为没有诱饵鱼钩来捕获它们，导致过去低估了鱼类种群。此外，在早期的延绳钓中，很多鱼被鲨鱼上钩后丢失。这不再是问题，因为现在周围的鲨鱼越来越少了。

paragraphs.sourceText: Dr. Myers and Dr. Worm argue that their work gives a correct baseline, which future management efforts must take into account. They believe the data support an idea current among marine biologists, that of the “shifting baseline”. The notion is that people have failed to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean because they have been looking back only a relatively short time into the past. That matters because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels. Most fisheries are well below that, which is a bad way to do business.
paragraphs.translationZh: 迈尔斯博士和沃姆博士认为，他们的工作提供了正确的基线，未来的管理工作必须考虑到这一点。他们认为这些数据支持海洋生物学家中流行的一个观点，即“基线移动”。人们的观点是，人们未能察觉到海洋中发生的巨大变化，因为他们只回顾了相对较短的过去。这很重要，因为理论表明，当目标物种的生物量约为其原始水平的 50% 时，渔业可实现最大可持续产量。大多数渔业的产量远低于这个水平，这是一种糟糕的经营方式。

paragraphs.sourceText: Many things make people think artists are weird. But the weirdest may be this: artists’ only job is to explore emotions, and yet they choose to focus on the ones that feel bad.
paragraphs.translationZh: 很多事情让人们觉得艺术家很奇怪。但最奇怪的可能是：艺术家唯一的工作就是探索情感，但他们却选择关注那些感觉不好的东西。

paragraphs.sourceText: This wasn’t always so. The earliest forms of art, like painting and music, are those best suited for expressing joy. But somewhere from the 19th century onward, more artists began seeing happiness as meaningless, phony or, worst of all, boring, as we went from Wordsworth’s daffodils to Baudelaire’s flowers of evil.
paragraphs.translationZh: 情况并非总是如此。最早的艺术形式，如绘画和音乐，是最适合表达欢乐的艺术形式。但从 19 世纪开始，随着我们从华兹华斯的水仙花转向波德莱尔的邪恶之花，越来越多的艺术家开始认为幸福是毫无意义的、虚假的，或者最糟糕的是，无聊的。

paragraphs.sourceText: You could argue that art became more skeptical of happiness because modern times have seen so much misery. But it’s not as if earlier times didn’t know perpetual war, disaster and the massacre of innocents. The reason, in fact, may be just the opposite: there is too much damn happiness in the world today.
paragraphs.translationZh: 你可以说艺术对幸福变得更加怀疑，因为现代已经看到了如此多的痛苦。但这并不是说早期时代不知道无休止的战争、灾难和对无辜者的屠杀。事实上，原因可能恰恰相反：当今世界有太多该死的幸福。

paragraphs.sourceText: After all, what is the one modern form of expression almost completely dedicated to depicting happiness? Advertising. The rise of anti-happy art almost exactly tracks the emergence of mass media, and with it, a commercial culture in which happiness is not just an ideal but an ideology.
paragraphs.translationZh: 毕竟，一种几乎完全致力于描绘幸福的现代表达形式是什么？广告。反幸福艺术的兴起几乎完全伴随着大众媒体的出现，以及随之而来的商业文化的出现，在这种文化中，幸福不仅是一种理想，而且是一种意识形态。

paragraphs.sourceText: People in earlier eras were surrounded by reminders of misery. They worked until exhausted, lived with few protections and died young. In the West, before mass communication and literacy, the most powerful mass medium was the church, which reminded worshippers that their souls were in danger and that they would someday be meat for worms. Given all this, they did not exactly need their art to be a bummer too.
paragraphs.translationZh: 早期时代的人们总是被痛苦的回忆所包围。他们工作到筋疲力尽，生活缺乏保护，英年早逝。在西方，在大众传播和识字之前，最强大的大众媒介是教堂，它提醒信徒，他们的灵魂处于危险之中，有一天他们会成为蠕虫的肉。考虑到这一切，他们并不完全希望自己的艺术也变得无赖。

paragraphs.sourceText: Today the messages the average Westerner is surrounded with are not religious but commercial, and forever happy. Fast-food eaters, news anchors, text messengers, all smiling, smiling, smiling. Our magazines feature beaming celebrities and happy families in perfect homes. And since these messages have an agenda — to lure us to open our wallets — they make the very idea of happiness seem unreliable. “Celebrate!” commanded the ads for the arthritis drug Celebrex, before we found out it could increase the risk of heart attacks.
paragraphs.translationZh: 今天，普通西方人周围的信息不再是宗教性的，而是商业性的，并且永远快乐。吃快餐的人、新闻主播、短信员，都在微笑、微笑、微笑。我们的杂志以笑容满面的名人和拥有完美住宅的幸福家庭为特色。由于这些信息有一个议程——引诱我们打开钱包——它们让幸福的概念看起来不可靠。 “庆祝！”在我们发现关节炎药物西乐葆会增加心脏病发作的风险之前，他就指挥了它的广告。

paragraphs.sourceText: But what we forget — what our economy depends on us forgetting — is that happiness is more than pleasure without pain. The things that bring the greatest joy carry the greatest potential for loss and disappointment. Today, surrounded by promises of easy happiness, we need art to tell us, as religion once did, Memento mori: remember that you will die, that everything ends, and that happiness comes not in denying this but in living with it. It’s a message even more bitter than a clove cigarette, yet, somehow, a breath of fresh air.
paragraphs.translationZh: 但我们忘记了——我们的经济依赖于我们的忘记——幸福不仅仅是没有痛苦的快乐。那些能带来最大快乐的事情也有可能带来最大的损失和失望。今天，我们被轻松幸福的承诺所包围，我们需要艺术来告诉我们，就像宗教曾经那样，“死亡的象征”：记住你会死，一切都会结束，幸福不是来自于否认这一点，而是来自于与它一起生活。这是一个比丁香香烟更苦涩的信息，但不知怎的，却是一股新鲜空气。

paragraphs.sourceText: On the north bank of the Ohio river sits Evansville, Ind., home of David Williams, 52, and of a riverboat casino (a place where gambling games are played). During several years of gambling in that casino, Williams, a state auditor earning $35,000 a year, lost approximately $175,000. He had never gambled before the casino sent him a coupon for $20 worth of gambling.
paragraphs.translationZh: 俄亥俄河北岸坐落着印第安纳州埃文斯维尔，52 岁的大卫·威廉姆斯 (David Williams) 的家，还有一家河船赌场（玩赌博游戏的地方）。威廉姆斯是一名年收入 35,000 美元的国家审计员，在该赌场赌博的几年中，他损失了大约 175,000 美元。在赌场给他发了一张价值20美元的赌博优惠券之前，他从未赌博过。

paragraphs.sourceText: He visited the casino, lost the $20 and left. On his second visit he lost $800. The casino issued to him, as a good customer, a “Fun Card,” which when used in the casino earns points for meals and drinks, and enables the casino to track the user’s gambling activities. For Williams, those activities became what he calls “electronic heroin.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 他去了赌场，输了 20 美元就离开了。第二次来时，他损失了 800 美元。作为好顾客，赌场向他发放了一张“欢乐卡”，在赌场使用该卡可以赚取积分用于餐饮，并使赌场能够跟踪用户的赌博活动。对于威廉姆斯来说，这些活动成为他所说的“电子海洛因”。

paragraphs.sourceText: (41) ______________________________. In 1997 he lost $21,000 to one slot machine in two days. In March 1997 he lost $72,186. He sometimes played two slot machines at a time, all night, until the boat docked at 5 a.m., then went back aboard when the casino opened at 9 a.m. Now he is suing the casino, charging that it should have refused his patronage because it knew he was addicted. It did know he had a problem.
paragraphs.translationZh: (41) ______________________________。 1997 年，他在一台老虎机上两天输了 21,000 美元。 1997 年 3 月，他损失了 72,186 美元。他有时会一次玩两台老虎机，玩一整晚，直到凌晨 5 点船靠岸，然后在赌场上午 9 点开门时才回到船上。现在他正在起诉赌场，指控赌场应该拒绝他的光顾，因为赌场知道他上瘾了。它确实知道他有问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: In March 1998, a friend of Williams’s got him involuntarily confined to a treatment center for addictions, and wrote to inform the casino of Williams’s gambling problem. The casino included a photo of Williams among those of banned gamblers, and wrote to him a “cease admissions” letter. Noting the “medical/psychological” nature of problem gambling behavior, the letter said that before being readmitted to the casino he would have to present medical/psychological information demonstrating that patronizing the casino would pose no threat to his safety or well-being.
paragraphs.translationZh: 1998年3月，威廉姆斯的一位朋友将他非自愿地送进了毒瘾治疗中心，并写信向赌场通报了威廉姆斯的赌博问题。赌场在被禁止的赌徒中放了一张威廉姆斯的照片，并给他写了一封“停止入场”的信。信中指出了问题赌博行为的“医疗/心理”性质，并表示在重新进入赌场之前，他必须提供医疗/心理信息，证明光顾赌场不会对他的安全或福祉构成威胁。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Wall Street Journal reports that the casino has 24 signs warning: “Enjoy the fun... and always bet with your head, not over it.” Every entrance ticket lists a toll-free number for counseling from the Indiana Department of Mental Health. Nevertheless, Williams’s suit charges that the casino, knowing he was “helplessly addicted to gambling,” intentionally worked to “lure” him to “engage in conduct against his will.” Well.
paragraphs.translationZh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，该赌场有 24 个标志警告：“享受乐趣……并始终用头脑下注，而不是过度投注。”每张门票上都列出了印第安纳州心理健康部的免费咨询电话。尽管如此，威廉姆斯的诉讼指控赌场知道他“无可奈何地沉迷于赌博”，故意“引诱”他“从事违背他意愿的行为”。出色地。

paragraphs.sourceText: The fourth edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders says “pathological gambling” involves persistent, recurring and uncontrollable pursuit less of money than of the thrill of taking risks in quest of a windfall.
paragraphs.translationZh: 《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》第四版称，“病态赌博”涉及持续、反复和无法控制的追求，与其说是为了金钱，不如说是为了追求意外之财而冒险的快感。

paragraphs.sourceText: (44) _______________________________. Pushed by science, or what claims to be science, society is reclassifying what once were considered character flaws or moral failings as personality disorders akin to physical disabilities.
paragraphs.translationZh: (44) _______________________________。在科学或自称科学的推动下，社会正在将曾经被认为是性格缺陷或道德缺陷的东西重新归类为类似于身体残疾的人格障碍。

paragraphs.sourceText: Forty-four states have lotteries, 29 have casinos, and most of these states are to varying degrees dependent on — you might say addicted to — revenues from wagering. And since the first Internet gambling site was created in 1995, competition for gamblers’ dollars has become intense. The Oct. 28 issue of Newsweek reported that 2 million gamblers patronize 1,800 virtual casinos every week. With $3.5 billion being lost on Internet wagers this year, gambling has passed pornography as the Web’s most profitable business.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44 个州有彩票，29 个州有赌场，其中大多数州都不同程度地依赖（你可能会说沉迷于）博彩收入。自从 1995 年第一个互联网赌博网站创建以来，赌徒资金的竞争就变得越来越激烈。 10 月 28 日《新闻周刊》报道称，每周有 200 万赌客光顾 1,800 家虚拟赌场。今年，随着互联网赌博损失了 35 亿美元，赌博已经超过色情业，成为网络上最赚钱的业务。

paragraphs.sourceText: A) Although no such evidence was presented, the casino’s marketing department continued to pepper him with mailings. And he entered the casino and used his Fun Card without being detected.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 尽管没有提供此类证据，赌场营销部门仍继续向他发送邮件。并且他进入赌场并使用了他的Fun Card而没有被发现。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) It is unclear what luring was required, given his compulsive behavior. And in what sense was his will operative?

paragraphs.sourceText: C) By the time he had lost $5,000 he said to himself that if he could get back to even, he would quit. One night he won $5,500, but he did not quit.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 当他输掉 5,000 美元时，他对自己说，如果他能追平，他就会放弃。一天晚上，他赢得了 5,500 美元，但他并没有放弃。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) Gambling has been a common feature of American life forever, but for a long time it was broadly considered a sin, or a social disease. Now it is a social policy: the most important and aggressive promoter of gambling in America is the government.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 赌博永远是美国人生活的一个共同特征，但长期以来它被广泛认为是一种罪恶，或者一种社会疾病。现在它是一项社会政策：美国赌博最重要和最积极的推动者是政府。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) David Williams’s suit should trouble this gambling nation. But don’t bet on it.

paragraphs.sourceText: F) It is worrisome that society is medicalizing more and more behavioral problems, often defining as addictions what earlier, sterner generations explained as weakness of will.

paragraphs.sourceText: G) The anonymous, lonely, undistracted nature of online gambling is especially conducive to compulsive behavior. But even if the government knew how to move against Internet gambling, what would be its grounds for doing so?
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 在线赌博的匿名、孤独、不分心的性质特别有利于强迫行为。但即使政府知道如何打击网络赌博，其这样做的理由是什么？

paragraphs.sourceText: Is it true that the American intellectual is rejected and considered of no account in his society? I am going to suggest that it is not true. Father Bruckberger told part of the story when he observed that it is the intellectuals who have rejected America. But they have done more than that. They have grown dissatisfied with the role of the intellectual. It is they, not America, who have become anti-intellectual.
paragraphs.translationZh: 美国知识分子在他的社会中是否受到排斥并被认为无足轻重？我要指出的是，这不是真的。布鲁克伯格神父讲述了这个故事的一部分，他观察到是知识分子拒绝了美国。但他们所做的还不止这些。他们对知识分子的角色越来越不满。是他们，而不是美国，变得反智了。

paragraphs.sourceText: First, the object of our study pleads for definition. What is an intellectual? (46) I shall define him as an individual who has elected as his primary duty and pleasure in life the activity of thinking in a Socratic (苏格拉底) way about moral problems. He explores such
paragraphs.translationZh: 首先，我们的研究对象需要定义。什么是知识分子？ (46) 我将把他定义为一个以苏格拉底方式思考道德问题的活动作为他的首要职责和生活乐趣的人。他探索这样的

paragraphs.sourceText: problems consciously, articulately, and frankly, first by asking factual questions, then by asking moral questions, finally by suggesting action which seems appropriate in the light of the factual and moral information which he has obtained. (47) His function is analogous to that of a judge, who must accept the obligation of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning which led him to his decision.
paragraphs.translationZh: 有意识地、清晰地、坦率地提出问题，首先提出事实问题，然后提出道德问题，最后提出根据他所获得的事实和道德信息看来适当的行动。 (47) 他的职能类似于法官的职能，法官必须承担以尽可能明显的方式揭示导致他做出决定的推理过程的义务。

paragraphs.sourceText: This definition excludes many individuals usually referred to as intellectuals — the average scientist, for one. (48) I have excluded him because, while his accomplishments may contribute to the solution of moral problems, he has not been charged with the task of approaching any but the factual aspects of those problems. Like other human beings, he encounters moral issues even in the everyday performance of his routine duties — he is not supposed to cook his experiments, manufacture evidence, or doctor his reports. (49) But his primary task is not to think about the moral code which governs his activity, any more than a businessman is expected to dedicate his energies to an exploration of rules of conduct in business. During most of his waking life he will take his code for granted, as the businessman takes his ethics.
paragraphs.translationZh: 这个定义排除了许多通常被称为知识分子的个人——其中之一就是普通科学家。 (48) 我之所以将他排除在外，是因为虽然他的成就可能有助于解决道德问题，但除了解决这些问题的事实方面之外，他没有承担任何其他任务。和其他人一样，即使在日常履行日常职责时，他也会遇到道德问题——他不应该做实验、捏造证据或篡改报告。 (49) 但他的首要任务不是思考支配其活动的道德准则，正如商人不应该将精力投入到探索商业行为规则上一样。在他醒着的大部分时间里，他都会认为自己的准则是理所当然的，就像商人认为自己的道德规范一样。

paragraphs.sourceText: The definition also excludes the majority of teachers, despite the fact that teaching has traditionally been the method whereby many intellectuals earn their living. (50) They may teach very well, and more than earn their salaries, but most of them make little or no independent reflections on human problems which involve moral judgment. This description even fits the majority of eminent scholars. Being learned in some branch of human knowledge is one thing; living in “public and illustrious thoughts,” as Emerson would say, is something else.
paragraphs.translationZh: 该定义还排除了大多数教师，尽管传统上教学一直是许多知识分子谋生的方法。 (50) 他们可能教得很好，而且赚的不仅仅是薪水，但他们中的大多数人很少或根本没有对涉及道德判断的人类问题进行独立思考。这种描述甚至适合大多数著名学者。学习人类知识的某个分支是一回事，但学习人类知识的某些领域是一回事。正如爱默生所说，生活在“公共和杰出的思想”中是另一回事。
